lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Read the Hotel's Allergen Chart Before the Buffet
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Read a printed allergen chart with staff, flag what is out of date, and explain what to verify before eating.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are reading the hotel's allergen chart with the AI, host Renzo, for your partner Elif, who is allergic to sesame: go through each bread and spread, ask clear questions, and say what to check using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.
lessons.sourceGrammarFocusEnglish: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de servirte, hay que preguntar; la tabla dice que contiene sésamo)

sourceWordsEnglish.en: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
After reading the label, let's ask about the ingredients and preparation before deciding whether to order.
My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
Better not eat anything without confirming it first.

sourcePassageEnglish: In the dining room of a hotel in Miraflores, in Lima, Elif and I arrive early for the breakfast buffet.
I tell Elif: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
Renzo, the host, brings us the printed allergen chart and puts it on the table.
I explain to Renzo: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
After reading the first column, I ask him: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
Renzo points to the date last updated, March 3, but the hotel has had a new bread supplier since September.
I read aloud: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
But the sliced bread from the new supplier has seeds on top, and the chart says nothing about that.
I tell Renzo: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
Then I ask him: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
While Renzo goes to the kitchen, I tell Elif: After reading the label, let's ask about the ingredients and preparation before deciding whether to order.
After talking to the head chef, Renzo comes back with the spec sheet for the sliced bread and the label for the French roll.
The spec sheet confirms that the seeds on the sliced bread are sesame.
The French roll's label says: May contain traces of sesame.
So I tell Elif: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.
Renzo says the head chef could use separate utensils for scrambled eggs, but cannot yet confirm all ingredients or cross-contact; we ask about another meal or skip the buffet.
Before eating, Elif checks that she has her epinephrine auto-injector in her bag.
I explain to Renzo that if Elif has an allergic reaction, we have to use the auto-injector as her doctor instructed and call an ambulance.

sourceVerbsEnglish.exampleEnglish: Renzo confirms the ingredients with the head chef.
I check each label before breakfast.
I read the allergen chart with Renzo.
I ask the head chef for the spec sheet.

sourceGrammarExamplesEnglish: Before trying the bread, you have to read the label.
After talking to the kitchen, Renzo will confirm the ingredients for us.
lessons.objectiveFrenchCourseEnglish: Comparer l’affichage aux étiquettes actuelles et demander des précisions sur les ingrédients et la préparation avant de choisir.
lessons.focusEnglish: Before and after with an infinitive; necessary checks: before choosing, ask staff; after reading a label, confirm preparation.
lessons.focusFrench: Avant de et après avoir avec l’infinitif ; vérifications nécessaires : avant de choisir, demander au personnel ; après avoir lu l’étiquette, vérifier la préparation.
lessons.teachingNotesEnglish: No food is represented as safe for a sesame-allergic guest. An outdated chart triggers ingredient/preparation/cross-contact questions and an alternative meal or no buffet food if staff cannot confirm.

words.en: We will not eat buffet food without clear confirmation.
words.fr: Nous ne mangerons rien au buffet sans confirmation claire.

english: At a Montréal hotel buffet, Elif and Sam read the printed allergen chart before choosing breakfast.
Elif has a sesame allergy and wants current ingredient and preparation information.
The host, Rémi, brings the chart to their table.
Sam asks when it was last updated.
Rémi notices that the date is older than the latest supplier change.
The chart says one bread roll has no sesame listed.
Sam says the old chart cannot confirm the current product.
Another bread has visible seeds, but their identity is not yet confirmed.
Sam asks for the current supplier label and product sheet.
He also asks how the bread is prepared and whether utensils or surfaces are shared.
Rémi checks with the kitchen manager instead of guessing.
The label for one item lists sesame.
For the other item, staff cannot confirm the preparation or possible cross-contact.
Elif and Sam do not choose either bread.
They ask whether there is another meal with verifiable details.
Rémi says he cannot confirm one at that moment.
Elif decides not to eat buffet food and uses her alternative breakfast plan.
Sam thanks Rémi for checking and asks the hotel to update the chart.
french: Au buffet d’un hôtel de Montréal, Elif et Sam lisent le tableau imprimé des allergènes avant de choisir leur petit-déjeuner.
Elif a une allergie au sésame et souhaite connaître les ingrédients et la préparation actuels.
L’hôte, Rémi, apporte le tableau à leur table.
Sam demande quand il a été mis à jour pour la dernière fois.
Rémi remarque que la date précède le dernier changement de fournisseur.
Le tableau n’indique pas de sésame pour un petit pain.
Sam dit que l’ancien tableau ne peut pas confirmer les caractéristiques du produit actuel.
Un autre pain porte des graines visibles, mais leur nature n’est pas encore confirmée.
Sam demande l’étiquette et la fiche actuelles du fournisseur.
Il demande aussi comment le pain est préparé et si les ustensiles ou les surfaces sont partagés.
Rémi vérifie auprès de la personne responsable de la cuisine au lieu de deviner.
L’étiquette d’un produit mentionne le sésame.
Pour l’autre produit, le personnel ne peut pas confirmer la préparation ni le contact croisé possible.
Elif et Sam ne choisissent aucun des deux pains.
Ils demandent s’il existe un autre repas dont les détails peuvent être vérifiés.
Rémi dit qu’il ne peut pas en confirmer un à ce moment-là.
Elif décide de ne rien manger au buffet et suit son autre plan pour le petit-déjeuner.
Sam remercie Rémi d’avoir vérifié et demande à l’hôtel de mettre le tableau à jour.

lessons.speakingInstructionEnglish: Read the dated chart with staff, ask about current labels, ingredients, preparation and cross-contact, and decline buffet food if details cannot be confirmed.
lessons.speakingFrench: Avant de choisir, vérifions la date du tableau. Pourriez-vous nous montrer l’étiquette actuelle et expliquer la préparation ? Si vous ne pouvez pas confirmer, nous ne prendrons rien au buffet.
lessons.regionalNotesEnglish: Québec food-allergen labeling, hotel buffet handling and sesame allergy decisions require qualified local allergy/food-safety review. No medical care or auto-injector instructions are taught.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Breakfast Room Closed: Propose a Fair Alternative
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Explain what the booking promised and what you found, then propose a reasonable breakfast alternative.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a hotel guest, and the AI is Yesenia, the receptionist in Cartagena: explain what your booking included and what you found this morning with the preterite and imperfect (bajé, estaba cerrada), then propose a fair alternative with ¿sería posible…?
lessons.sourceGrammarFocusEnglish: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (la reserva incluía desayuno, bajé a las ocho y estaba cerrado; ¿sería posible un vale?)

sourceWordsEnglish.en: My booking included breakfast, and the confirmation said so.
I went down at 8 and the terrace was closed.
There was no notice in the elevator or in the room.
I understand it wasn't your fault, don't worry.
Would a voucher for the café next door be possible?
Could you check it with the management, please?
If that's not possible, would you take the breakfast off my bill?
That seems like a fair solution, thank you very much.

sourcePassageEnglish: Daniel, a Canadian traveler, is spending three nights at a boutique hotel in the walled city of Cartagena.
He made the booking on a booking platform and paid the full price in advance.
According to the terms of the booking, breakfast on the terrace was included every day.
This morning Daniel goes to the front desk and talks with Yesenia, the receptionist.
Daniel: My booking included breakfast, and the confirmation said so.
Daniel: I went down at 8 and the terrace was closed.
Daniel: There was no notice in the elevator or in the room.
Yesenia: I'm very sorry, last night there was a leak and some urgent repairs started on the terrace.
Yesenia: It's a temporary closure, and nobody managed to put up the notice before 7.
Daniel: I understand it wasn't your fault, don't worry.
Daniel: I'm not looking for a refund, I just need an alternative for breakfast today.
Daniel: Would a voucher for the café next door be possible?
Daniel: If that's not possible, would you take the breakfast off my bill?
Yesenia: That seems reasonable to me, but any compensation has to be approved by the management.
Daniel: Could you check it with the management, please?
Yesenia calls her boss and, after 5 minutes, hands Daniel a voucher for a full breakfast.
Yesenia: In addition, we're offering you a 10% discount on the bill for the inconvenience.
Daniel: That seems like a fair solution, thank you very much.

sourceVerbsEnglish.exampleEnglish: The booking includes breakfast on the terrace.
I go down to have breakfast at 8.
Yesenia checks the case with the management.
Will you take the breakfast off my bill?
We're offering you a discount for the inconvenience.

sourceGrammarExamplesEnglish: I went down at 8 and the terrace was still closed.

lessons.objectiveFrenchCourseEnglish: Expliquer ce que confirmait la réservation et proposer une solution de petit-déjeuner sans présumer d’un droit au remboursement.
lessons.focusEnglish: Past background and conditional proposal: the booking included breakfast; the room was closed; would an alternative be possible?
lessons.focusFrench: Passé composé, imparfait et proposition au conditionnel : la réservation comprenait le petit-déjeuner ; la salle était fermée ; serait-il possible de trouver une autre solution ?
lessons.teachingNotesEnglish: No voucher, discount or refund is promised. Staff checks the booking terms and management approval before confirming an option.

passage.titleFrench: Demander une solution pour une salle fermée
english: Daniel is staying at a hotel in Québec City and has a booking confirmation that includes breakfast.
At eight, he goes downstairs and finds the breakfast room closed.
He sees no notice in his room about the closure.
Daniel brings his confirmation to the reception desk.
He tells the receptionist, Maude, what the booking said.
He explains that the breakfast room was closed when he arrived.
Maude says that repairs began unexpectedly that morning.
She apologizes for the missing notice.
Daniel asks what breakfast alternatives are available today.
He suggests that a voucher for a nearby café might work.
He also asks how the hotel would handle the bill if no alternative is available.
Maude says she needs to check the booking terms and speak with management.
Daniel agrees to wait for a clear answer before choosing.
Maude confirms the time when she expects to update him.
She does not promise a voucher, discount or refund.
Daniel asks whether he may get the answer in writing.
Maude says she will send a message after management has reviewed the case.
Daniel thanks her and goes to look at other breakfast options while he waits.
french: Daniel séjourne dans un hôtel à Québec et possède une confirmation de réservation qui comprend le petit-déjeuner.
À huit heures, il descend et trouve la salle du petit-déjeuner fermée.
Il n’a vu aucun avis dans sa chambre au sujet de la fermeture.
Daniel apporte sa confirmation à la réception.
Il dit à la réceptionniste, Maude, ce qu’indiquait la réservation.
Il explique que la salle du petit-déjeuner était fermée à son arrivée.
Maude dit que des travaux ont commencé de façon imprévue ce matin-là.
Elle s’excuse de l’absence d’avis.
Daniel demande quelles solutions de petit-déjeuner sont possibles aujourd’hui.
Il propose qu’un bon pour le café voisin pourrait convenir.
Il demande aussi comment l’hôtel traiterait la facture si aucune autre solution n’était disponible.
Maude dit qu’elle doit vérifier les conditions de réservation et consulter la direction.
Daniel accepte d’attendre une réponse claire avant de choisir.
Maude confirme à quel moment elle pense pouvoir le renseigner.
Elle ne promet ni bon, ni réduction, ni remboursement.
Daniel demande s’il peut recevoir la réponse par écrit.
Maude dit qu’elle enverra un message après l’examen du dossier par la direction.
Daniel la remercie et va regarder d’autres possibilités de petit-déjeuner pendant qu’il attend.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: No Oat Milk Today: Choose Substitutes for the Group
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Compare the available milk options for each person and agree on a plan until the delivery arrives.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are ordering for your friends, and the AI is Matías, a server at a San Telmo confitería: compare the milk options with más/menos … que, pick one for vegan Hannah and one for lactose-avoiding Dev, and plan the rest with ir a and the future (va a llegar, volveremos).
lessons.sourceGrammarFocusEnglish: Future and ir a; comparisons (la de soja es más espesa que la de almendra; el reparto va a llegar por la tarde)

sourceWordsEnglish.en: the milk with a drop of coffee
What time is the delivery going to arrive?
Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
Hannah is vegan; let's check the soy drink's ingredients and preparation before she chooses.
The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
What do you think, Hannah? The coconut one is less thick.
Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.

sourcePassageEnglish: One Saturday at 10, Nora walks into a café-bakery in San Telmo with her friends Hannah and Dev to have breakfast.
The server, Matías, tells them that there is no oat milk today because the delivery hasn't arrived yet.
Nora: What time is the delivery going to arrive?
Matías: It will arrive in the afternoon, and meanwhile I can offer you another plant-based drink.
Matías: We have soy and almond drinks, but I need to check their ingredients and how they are prepared.
Nora: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
Matías: Yes, the soy one is thicker, and the coconut milk has a sweeter taste than both.
Hannah: I prefer the soy one, because it makes more foam than the coconut one.
Nora: Hannah is vegan; let's check the soy drink's ingredients and preparation before she chooses.
Dev avoids lactose, so Matías recommends the lactose-free milk to him.
Nora: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
Dev: Yes, I'm going to order a lágrima, because it has less coffee than a cortado.
Nora: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
Matías: The baker says the croissant uses beef fat, but I cannot confirm that it is free of dairy or cross-contact without checking the full recipe and preparation.
Nora: Dev will wait on the croissants; Hannah wants to ask how the fruit salad is prepared before ordering.
Nora: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
Matías: Of course, and when the delivery arrives, I'm going to save some oat milk for you.
Nora: Once the drinks are confirmed, we'll order them; otherwise we'll choose another option and come back in the afternoon.

sourceVerbsEnglish.exampleEnglish: The delivery arrives in the afternoon.
Hannah has a coffee with soy milk.
Dev orders a lágrima with lactose-free milk.
Hannah prefers the soy one because it makes more foam.
We come back in the afternoon for the oat milk.

passage.titleFrench: Comparer des boissons sans promettre leur composition
english: Nora enters a café-bakery in Brussels with her friends Hannah and Dev.
The server says the oat drink is unavailable today.
Nora asks when the next delivery is expected.
The server says it might arrive in the afternoon but cannot promise it.
He lists soy, almond and coconut drinks as possible alternatives.
Nora asks which drink is thicker and which has more foam.
The server describes the texture but says he must check the current ingredients.
Hannah says she is vegan and wants preparation details too.
Dev says he avoids lactose and asks about the lactose-free milk.
Nora asks the server to check the labels and shared equipment before either friend decides.
The server goes to ask the kitchen instead of guessing.
Nora asks whether the croissants contain butter or other dairy ingredients.
The server says the recipe must be checked before he can answer fully.
Hannah and Dev decide not to order pastries while the details are unclear.
The server returns with current drink labels but cannot confirm shared preparation.
Hannah and Dev choose to wait or use another café rather than assume a drink is suitable.
Nora thanks the server for checking and asks when they may follow up.
They leave without treating the expected delivery as confirmed.
french: Nora entre dans un café-boulangerie à Bruxelles avec ses amis Hannah et Dev.
Le serveur dit que la boisson à l’avoine est indisponible aujourd’hui.
Nora demande quand la prochaine livraison est prévue.
Le serveur dit qu’elle pourrait arriver dans l’après-midi, sans pouvoir le promettre.
Il cite les boissons au soja, à l’amande et à la noix de coco comme solutions possibles.
Nora demande quelle boisson est plus épaisse et laquelle produit davantage de mousse.
Le serveur décrit la texture, mais dit qu’il doit vérifier les ingrédients actuels.
Hannah dit qu’elle est végétalienne et souhaite aussi des précisions sur la préparation.
Dev dit qu’il évite le lactose et pose des questions sur le lait sans lactose.
Nora demande au serveur de vérifier les étiquettes et le matériel partagé avant que ses amis décident.
Le serveur va interroger la cuisine au lieu de deviner.
Nora demande si les croissants contiennent du beurre ou d’autres ingrédients laitiers.
Le serveur dit que la recette doit être vérifiée avant qu’il puisse répondre complètement.
Hannah et Dev décident de ne pas commander de viennoiseries tant que les détails restent incertains.
Le serveur revient avec les étiquettes actuelles des boissons, mais ne peut pas confirmer la préparation partagée.
Hannah et Dev choisissent d’attendre ou d’aller dans un autre café plutôt que de supposer qu’une boisson leur convient.
Nora remercie le serveur d’avoir vérifié et demande quand ils pourront reprendre contact.
Ils partent sans considérer la livraison prévue comme certaine.
